title: Account
description: Your details, notifications, and privacy choices.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: Your photo and name, as people see them on TasksNearMe.
profile.firstNameHint: The name people know you by.
profile.lastNameHint: Only your initial appears in your display name.

contact.title: Contact details
contact.description: Where we send sign-in codes, receipts and booking updates. Each change is confirmed with a 6-digit code.
contact.noPhoneHint: Helpers and people who book need one. You can add it now or when you need it.
contact.emailChanged: Your email is now {email}. Use it the next time you sign in.
contact.phoneChanged: Your new phone number is verified.

emailDialog.title: Change your email
emailDialog.description: We'll send a 6-digit code to the new address. Your email stays the same until you enter it.
emailDialog.label: New email
emailDialog.hint: Sign-in codes, receipts and updates will go here.
emailDialog.codeDescription: Enter the 6-digit code we sent to {email}. It works for {minutes, number} minutes.

phoneDialog.description: We'll text a 6-digit code to confirm the number. Your current number stays until you enter it.
phoneDialog.addDescription: We'll text a 6-digit code to confirm the number. Message and data rates may apply.
phoneDialog.codeDescription: Enter the 6-digit code we texted to {phone}. It works for {minutes, number} minutes.

contact.newCodeSent: A new code is on its way.
contact.held: Someone told us a recent change to your email or phone wasn't you, so email, phone and sign-in changes are paused while our team checks your account.

signIn.title: Ways to sign in
signIn.description: We email you a code each time you sign in. You can also connect Google or Microsoft and sign in with them.
signIn.hint: Disconnecting doesn't close your account. You can always sign in with an email code.
signIn.disconnected: {provider} is disconnected. You can still sign in with an email code.

notice.connected: {provider} is connected. Next time you can continue with {provider} to sign in.
notice.already_used: That {provider} account already signs in to another TasksNearMe account.
notice.email_unconfirmed: {provider} didn't confirm the email address on that account, so it can't be connected.
notice.failed: Something went wrong connecting {provider}. Try again.

signIn.held: Connecting Google or Microsoft is paused while our team checks your account. You can still disconnect one, and the email code keeps working.

preferences.title: Notifications
preferences.description: Choose how you hear about your tasks and bookings. Changes save as you make them.
preferences.caption: Notification preferences by topic and channel
preferences.locked: Receipts and safety messages can't be turned off.
preferences.quietHours: Texts that can wait arrive after 8 am. Day-of booking updates, like a helper on the way or a cancellation, come right away.
preferences.notAllowed: This preference can't be changed. Your previous setting has been restored.

language.title: Language
language.description: Choose the language for the app, emails and texts.
language.hint: The page reloads in the language you choose.
language.failed: We couldn't change your language. Try again.

descriptions.none: Offer local help with the same account.
descriptions.draft: Your helper profile is started. Finish setting it up to offer help.
descriptions.active: Your helper profile is active. Keep your services and details up to date.
descriptions.paused: Your helper profile is paused. You can still edit your details.
descriptions.suspended: Your helper account is suspended. Contact support.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.exportDescription: Get a copy of everything linked to your account, as a file you can keep.
privacy.requestExport: Request a copy of my data
privacy.exportSubmitted: We're preparing your copy. We'll email you when it's ready.
privacy.deletionDescription: Deleting your account removes your profile, contact details and photos, and signs you out everywhere. Bookings, payments and reviews stay as records, without your name.
privacy.confirmDescription: We'll delete your account in {days} days, and you can change your mind until then. Finish or cancel any open bookings first.
privacy.deletionSubmitted: Deletion requested. It happens in {days} days unless you keep your account.
privacy.deletionBlocked: Finish or cancel your open bookings first.
privacy.exportPreparing: Preparing your copy (asked for {date}). We'll email you when it's ready, usually within a few minutes.
privacy.deletionScheduled: Your account will be deleted on {date}.
privacy.deletionWaiting: {reason, select, open_bookings {It waits until your open bookings are finished or canceled.} open_case {It waits until your open support case is closed.} money_on_its_way {It waits until the money on its way to you has arrived.} other {It waits until nothing is open.}}
privacy.deletionCanceled: Your account stays. Nothing was deleted.

previews.emailChange: Changing the email: the code step
previews.emailInUse: Changing the email: address already used
previews.unsubscribeConfirm: Unsubscribe from an email: asks first
previews.unsubscribeLocked: Unsubscribe link for emails that can't be turned off
previews.deletionWaiting: Account · deletion waiting for a booking
previews.contactHeld: Account · changes paused after “This wasn’t me”
previews.notMeDone: “This wasn’t me” link: account being secured
previews.notMeInvalid: “This wasn’t me” link that can’t be used
previews.notMeRateLimited: “This wasn’t me” link: too many tries

unsubscribe.title: Email preferences
unsubscribe.confirmText: You'll still see these updates in the app. Booking and payment emails keep coming: they're your receipts and safety updates.
unsubscribe.doneText: You'll still see these updates in your notifications in the app.
unsubscribe.lockedTitle: These emails can't be turned off
unsubscribe.lockedText: Booking and payment emails are your receipts and safety updates, so they always come.
unsubscribe.invalidText: It may have been copied only in part. You can choose which emails you get in your account.

passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.description: Sign in with your device's lock (Face ID, Touch ID, Windows Hello or a security key) instead of a code. The email code keeps working.
passkeys.nameHint: So you can tell them apart, like 'iPhone' or 'Work laptop'.
passkeys.added: Passkey added. Next time, sign in with it.
passkeys.held: Adding a passkey is paused while our team checks your account. You can still remove one.

descriptions.helper: Each check you've passed, and what's left before you can take tasks.
descriptions.client: Your verified phone, and any ID check our team asked for.
descriptions.clientIdOnly: The ID check our team asked for, and where it stands.

activity.title: Activity
activity.description: Whether the people you talk to see when you're around.
activity.label: Show when I'm active
activity.on: On: they see “Active now” or “Active today”, and “Seen” on messages.
activity.off: Off: nobody sees your activity, and you don't see theirs.
activity.hint: Only people you share a conversation or booking with ever see it, never exact times, and never on your public profile.

ask.title: Didn't make this change?
ask.text: If you didn't change the email or phone number on your TasksNearMe account, we'll secure it now. You don't need to sign in.

items.signOut: Every device signed in to the account is signed out.
items.undo: The change is undone, if it was made in the last {days} days.
items.signIns: Passkeys and Google or Microsoft sign-ins added around the time of the change are removed.
items.pause: Email, phone and sign-in changes are paused until our team has checked the account.

ask.madeIt: Made the change yourself? You can close this page.

done.title: Your account is being secured
done.text: Thanks for telling us. Every device on the account has been signed out.

items.team: Our trust and safety team checks the account and writes to you. Until then, email, phone and sign-in changes are paused.
items.signIn: You can sign in again with a code sent to your email.
items.more: Something else to tell us, or your email doesn't work any more? Contact support.

invalid.title: This link can't be used
invalid.text: It may have been used already, be more than {days} days old, or have been copied only in part.

items.contact: If you're worried about your account, tell our support team what happened. They can secure it for you.
